up: Return exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4296187. For each matching activity, provide the activity ID, standard relation, standard value, standard units, standard type, and document ID. Additionally, return the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and standard InChI for the corresponding compound.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type, a.doc_id, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, cs.standard_inchi FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296187' AND a.standard_relation = '='
